query:
fragment PlaylistFields on Playlist {
    id
    uuid
    boardType
    layoutId
    name
    description
    isPublic
    color
    icon
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    lastAccessedAt
    climbCount
    userRole
    followerCount
    isFollowedByMe
    isPinnedByMe
  }

  query GetAllUserPlaylists($input: GetAllUserPlaylistsInput!) {
    allUserPlaylists(input: $input) {
      playlists {
        ...PlaylistFields
      }
      totalCount
      hasMore
    }
  }
